claim: The fix was made in TransferDesk.jsx
fetchLatest merged live feed updates into a Map keyed by the feed record's id
The backend classifies each newly ingested tweet/article into its own record
The backend contract is documented in the file's own docstring
When a transfer progresses from 'In Talks' to 'Done & Confirmed' the backend can send it under a fresh id rather than updating the original one
Both the stale talks record and the new done record survived in the transfers collection simultaneously
The board filters strictly by category
The same player rendered in both columns at once due to duplicate records with different ids
The merge always rebuilt from the static SEED_TRANSFERS constant instead of current state
Previously-applied live updates could be silently discarded on the next poll due to resetting to seed baseline
The fix deduplicates by the transfer's real identity using player and kind instead of the raw feed id
The fix merges on top of current transfers state via a functional setTransfers update instead of resetting to SEED_TRANSFERS each poll
